ports.name: clk_i
ports.function: provides global clock to module (module receives clock)
ports.evidence: tested in rising_edge(clk_i) in multiple sequential processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.function: provides global active-low reset (module receives reset)
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... initialize registers in processes

ports.name: jtag_tck_i
ports.function: JTAG TCK input; sampled and edge-detected (module receives)

ports.name: jtag_tdi_i
ports.function: JTAG TDI input; shifted into TAP registers (module receives)
ports.evidence: tap_sync.tdi_ff <= ... & jtag_tdi_i; used to shift tap_reg.*

ports.name: jtag_tdo_o
ports.function: JTAG TDO output; module drives serial data out
ports.evidence: jtag_tdo_o <= tap_reg.* values on tck falling (serial output)

ports.name: jtag_tms_i
ports.function: JTAG TMS input; controls TAP state transitions (module receives)
ports.evidence: tap_control FSM uses tap_sync.tms to choose next tap_ctrl_state

ports.name: dmi_req_o
ports.function: DMI request output record; module drives requests to DM

ports.name: dmi_req_o.addr
ports.function: DMI request address output; module drives address field

ports.name: dmi_req_o.op
ports.function: DMI request operation output; module drives opcode field

ports.name: dmi_req_o.data
ports.function: DMI request data output; module drives write-data field

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i
ports.function: DMI response input record; module receives responses from DM

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i.data
ports.function: DMI response read-data input; module consumes returned data

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i.ack
ports.function: DMI response ack input; module receives completion acknowledgement

signals.name: tap_sync
signals.function: synchronizes incoming JTAG signals to clk_i
signals.evidence: tap_synchronizer process shifts jtag_tck_i/tdi_i/tms_i into tap_sync.* FFs

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_ff
signals.function: three-stage shift register for sampled TCK
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tck_ff <= tap_sync.tck_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tck_i in clocked process

signals.name: tap_sync.tdi_ff
signals.function: three-stage shift register for sampled TDI
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tdi_ff <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tdi_i in clocked process

signals.name: tap_sync.tms_ff
signals.function: three-stage shift register for sampled TMS
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tms_ff <= tap_sync.tms_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tms_i in clocked process

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_rising
signals.function: indicates rising edge of synchronized TCK
signals.evidence: assigned '1' when tap_sync.tck_ff(2 downto 1) = "01"

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_falling
signals.function: indicates falling edge of synchronized TCK
signals.evidence: assigned '1' when tap_sync.tck_ff(2 downto 1) = "10"

signals.name: tap_sync.tdi
signals.function: synchronized TDI sample (latest stage)
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tdi <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(2) concurrent assignment

signals.name: tap_sync.tms
signals.function: synchronized TMS sample (latest stage)
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tms <= tap_sync.tms_ff(2) concurrent assignment

signals.name: tap_ctrl_state
signals.function: current state of the JTAG TAP controller FSM
signals.evidence: tap_control process updates state on tap_sync.tck_rising and tap_sync.tms

signals.name: tap_reg
signals.function: collection of TAP shift and status registers
signals.evidence: tap_reg fields loaded/shifted in reg_access clocked process

signals.name: tap_reg.ireg
signals.function: JTAG instruction register (shift/load IR)
signals.evidence: ireg preloaded at IR_CAPTURE and shifted in IR_SHIFT on tck rising

signals.name: tap_reg.bypass
signals.function: single-bit bypass data register for JTAG chain
signals.evidence: bypass <= '0' on DR_CAPTURE others; assigned tap_sync.tdi in DR_SHIFT

signals.name: tap_reg.idcode
signals.function: device IDCODE register contents
signals.evidence: idcode <= IDCODE_VERSION & PARTID & MANID & '1' in DR_CAPTURE; shifted in DR_SHIFT

signals.name: tap_reg.dtmcs
signals.function: DTM control and status register storage
signals.evidence: dtmcs loaded from dtmcs_nxt in DR_CAPTURE and shifted in DR_SHIFT

signals.name: tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt
signals.function: composes dtmcs readback (status & control) bits
signals.evidence: concurrent assignments set dtmcs_nxt fields from dmi_ctrl and constants

signals.name: tap_reg.dmi
signals.function: DMI register (address,data,op) shift storage
signals.evidence: dmi <= dmi_nxt in DR_CAPTURE; shifted on DR_SHIFT from tap_sync.tdi

signals.name: tap_reg.dmi_nxt
signals.function: composes DMI readback (addr,rdata,status)
signals.evidence: tap_reg.dmi_nxt <= dmi_ctrl.addr & dmi_ctrl.rdata & replicate_f(dmi_ctrl.err,2)

signals.name: dr_trigger
signals.function: edge-detection trigger for DR_UPDATE events
signals.evidence: dr_trigger.sreg updated in update_trigger clocked process

signals.name: dr_trigger.sreg
signals.function: two-stage register to detect DR_UPDATE rising edge
signals.evidence: sreg(0) <= '1' when tap_ctrl_state = DR_UPDATE; sreg(1) <= sreg(0)

signals.name: dr_trigger.valid
signals.function: high for one cycle on DR_UPDATE rising edge
signals.evidence: dr_trigger.valid <= '1' when (dr_trigger.sreg = "01") else '0'

signals.name: dmi_ctrl
signals.function: DMI arbiter and transaction state registers
signals.evidence: dmi_controller process initializes and updates dmi_ctrl fields on clk

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.busy
signals.function: indicates DMI transaction in progress
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.busy set to '1' when op assigned; cleared on dmi_rsp_i.ack

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.op
signals.function: pending DMI operation code (read/write/none)
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.op assigned default then set to tap_reg.dmi(1 downto 0) on request

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset
signals.function: sticky hard-reset control for debug module
signals.evidence: arbiter checks (dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset = '0') before accepting DMI access

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.dmireset
signals.function: software-controlled DMI reset flag from dtmcs
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.dmireset <= tap_reg.dtmcs(16) on dr_trigger; used to clear err

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.err
signals.function: sticky error flag for illegal DMI access attempts
signals.evidence: set when busy='1' and dr_trigger.valid='1' and tap_reg.ireg = addr_dmi_c

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.rdata
signals.function: stores read data returned from DMI target
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.rdata <= dmi_rsp_i.data while busy handling in dmi_controller

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.wdata
signals.function: stores write data for outgoing DMI request
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.wdata <= tap_reg.dmi(33 downto 02) when accepting request

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.addr
signals.function: stores address for outgoing DMI request
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.addr <= tap_reg.dmi(40 downto 34) when accepting request
